scope.flow: Launchpad.buy curve fill followed by graduation and AMM exact-out leg
scope.environment: Launchpad bonding curve with CPMM AMM graduation
evidence: - Root cause: Slippage is enforced only on the curve portion in `Launchpad.buy`, not on the combined curve+AMM execution after graduation. An attacker can first push bonding near completion (cheaply when Vb is small), then frontrun to force a tiny curve fill and trigger graduation; the CPMM’s marginal price near end is hyperbolic.

- Impact: Victim’s `maxAmountInQuote` is largely consumed by an extremely expensive tiny curve fill; remaining quote is insufficient for the AMM exact-out leg, so victim gets only a tiny amount at a terrible effective price. Attacker’s trade is typically unprofitable (griefing), but reliably harms users.
- Remaining quote ≪ requiredQuote → AMM leg fails; victim ends with only Z = 1 base.
